intent: Fifteen minutes with my doctor on Thursday about headaches I've had for a few weeks. What should I walk in with?
What should I be asking the specialist about switching treatments? I want a short list I can hand over.
Pull the last three months of my notes into a one-page timeline the clinician can read quickly.
I want to start writing down what I take and how I feel each day.
Before the visit I'd like to work out why I keep waking at three every morning.
Read the radiology report and tell me whether the mass is cancer.
note: asks for a diagnosis rather than visit preparation; no skill makes clinical determinations
